ui.add.title: Become a contributor
ui.add.intro: Animundo is made by the families who play it. Every animal, plant and place is one small file, which you can make together with an AI assistant. No programming needed.
ui.add.step1: 1. Choose a real animal or plant, or a real place your family loves, like a forest, a lake or a national park.
ui.add.step2: 2. Open the community page. It has a prompt to copy into an AI assistant (like Claude), which writes the file with real facts.
ui.add.step3: 3. Try it in the game and fix anything that looks wrong.
ui.add.step4: 4. A local expert checks the facts. Then everyone can play it, with your nickname in the credits.
ui.add.note: Opening soon: we're still getting the contributor terms ready. Children under 16 take part through a parent, guardian or teacher.

ui.devices.intro: Your animals can live on a phone and a tablet at the same time. Get a code on one device. On the other device, open Your animals, tap Play on another device and type the code.
ui.devices.code_note: Type this code on the other device within {minutes} minutes. It works once.
ui.devices.code_failed: Couldn't get a code. Check the internet connection and try again.
ui.devices.enter_note: Type the code shown on your other device.
ui.devices.done: Done! Both devices now have the same animals.
ui.devices.bad_code: That code didn't work. A code works once, for {minutes} minutes. Check the internet connection too.
ui.story.title: Our story
ui.story.p1: I started talking with my son Daniel about what kind of game we could build for him. Daniel had just turned 7, and on our trips to school and back home we would talk about games.
ui.story.p2: Animundo: Animal Kingdom is one of the ideas we had. You play as real animals and do what real animals do. This way you learn about nature and animals.
ui.new.locked: Needs an account, ask a grown-up for help
ui.account.title: For grown-ups
ui.account.kid: Want more animals? Ask a grown-up to help you unlock them.
ui.account.what: A free account unlocks every animal. Your child's animals are also kept safe and can be played on all your devices.
ui.account.privacy: We only keep your email address, to send you sign-in links. No password, no ads, and we never share it. Your child never signs in.
ui.account.agree: By continuing you agree to the terms of use and the privacy policy.
ui.account.bad_email: That doesn't look like an email address.
ui.account.send_failed: Couldn't send the email. Check the internet connection and try again.
ui.account.sent_note: Open the link on this device to finish. No email? Look in the spam folder.
ui.account.signed_in_note: Every animal is unlocked. To play on another device, tap More animals there and sign in with the same email, or use Play on another device under Your animals.
ui.account.need_email: To finish, type the email address the link was sent to.
ui.account.offline: Couldn't reach Animundo. Check the internet connection and try again.
ui.account.bad_link: This sign-in link has already been used or is too old.
ui.timer.title: Play timer
ui.timer.intro: Choose how long your child can play each day. When time is up, the animal falls asleep and the game saves. Only time spent playing counts, and it starts again at midnight. The timer is kept on this device.

ui.timer.rest_body_any: Playtime is over for today. Come back tomorrow!

ui.problem.privacy: Please don't write names or contact details. We send this with anonymous details about the game and the device, never the player's ID.

ui.problem.reports: Send anonymous health reports (errors, crashes) automatically

ui.plans.title: Plans
ui.plans.intro: Animundo is free to try. When it's finished, the full version will cost a little, paid once. Part of every purchase goes to nature conservation through Animundo ry.
ui.plans.free_what: A few starter animals. No time limit, and the animals are always saved.
ui.plans.full_what: Every animal and every place, and all the new ones we make later.
ui.plans.supporter_what: The same full version. You pay a bit more, and the extra goes to nature conservation.
ui.plans.no_sub: No subscription, no ads, and nothing to buy inside the game.
ui.checkout.title: Payment
ui.checkout.nature: Thank you for helping us make Animundo, and for helping nature.
